info.name: CalisHealth - Survey API
info.description: Kiem thu Dynamic Survey Engine (onboarding). Chay bang Collection Runner TU TREN XUONG voi environment "CalisHealth - Local". Huong dan day du: postman/README-Survey.md.

item.name: 00. Setup - dang nhap
item.description: Dang nhap 2 tai khoan (da verify email) va luu JWT vao environment. Tai khoan tao 1 lan theo huong dan trong postman/README-Survey.md.

request.description: Positive #1. Tra ve version ACTIVE: cac buoc, cau hoi, loai, rules, options, dieu kien.

exec: pm.test('4 buoc dung thu tu', () => pm.expect(j.steps.map(s => s.stepCode)).to.eql(['BODY_INFORMATION','GOALS_AND_MOTIVATION','CURRENT_TRAINING_ROUTINE','LEVEL_TEST']));
pm.test('AGE la NUMBER co rules', () => { pm.expect(age.questionType).to.eql('NUMBER'); pm.expect(age.validationRules).to.include({min: 13, max: 100, integerOnly: true}); });
pm.test('GENDER co options tu DB', () => pm.expect(gender.options.map(o => o.optionCode)).to.include.members(['MALE','FEMALE']));
pm.test('HEALTH_GOAL co dieu kien', () => pm.expect(healthGoal.conditionalRules).to.eql({operator: 'EQ', questionCode: 'GOAL_TYPE', value: 'HEALTH'}));

item.name: Doi GOAL_TYPE ve HEALTH nhung KHONG xoa TRAINING_SKILLS

request.description: Chuan bi cho test duoi: cau phu thuoc cu khong bi xoa tu dong, chi bi danh dau applicable=false.

exec: const q = (code) => pm.response.json().steps.flatMap(s => s.questions).find(x => x.questionCode === code);
pm.test('TRAINING_SKILLS van con nhung khong ap dung', () => { pm.expect(q('TRAINING_SKILLS').answered).to.be.true; pm.expect(q('TRAINING_SKILLS').applicable).to.be.false; });
